# Repository adoption record

Use one record per destination. This records observed content and settings state; it is not organization-wide certification. Do not fill unknown values from guesswork.

## Identity and review

- Destination repository URL:
- Destination visibility and default branch:
- Destination full revision inspected:
- Inspection date:
- Shared source repository and full source revision:
- Adoption PR URL and merged revision, if they exist:
- Destination owner role:
- Reviewer role and actual review date:
- Intended consumers and access limitations:

## Minimum content

For each row, choose applicable / copied / linked / configured / verified / blocked / deferred / unknown. Put commands or evidence links in the last column.
